/**
 * @name Dangerous Sinks
 * @description Detects calls to dangerous functions like eval, exec, and subprocess execution.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/dangerous-sinks
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Call to dangerous function."

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Trace URL source in ocspclient
 * @description Traces where the URL argument to urllib comes from in tools/ocspclient.py
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/ocspclient-url-trace
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

module UrlFlowConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    // Check for command line arguments or other external inputs
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
    or
    source = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource()
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      (
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall()
        or
        call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember("urlopen").getACall()
      )
      and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module UrlFlow = TaintTracking::Global<UrlFlowConfig>;
import UrlFlow::PathGraph

from UrlFlow::PathNode source, UrlFlow::PathNode sink
where UrlFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "URL argument comes from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: The URL argument to urllib in tools/ocspclient.py is controlled by user input (command line arguments), potentially leading to SSRF.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect urllib call arguments in ocspclient.py
 * @description Inspect the arguments passed to urllib/urllib2 in ocspclient.py to see if they come from CLI args
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-urllib-args
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "ocspclient.py" and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember("urlopen").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib.request").getMember("urlopen").getACall()
  )
select call, "urllib call found with argument: " + call.getArg(0).asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: The URL argument in the urllib call in ocspclient.py is derived from command-line arguments, leading to SSRF.
